packageRules.description: Kotlin and KSP must move together — KSP is version-locked to the Kotlin compiler.
Android Gradle Plugin on its own — major/minor bumps often need manual review.
All other AndroidX libraries in one PR.
Jetpack Compose (BOM + artifacts) grouped separately from the rest of AndroidX.
Hilt / Dagger compiler and runtime share versions — keep them in one PR.
security-crypto is alpha; never auto-open a PR — surface it on the dashboard for manual approval. Own groupName so the approval gate doesn't propagate to the rest of the AndroidX group.
